blocks.text: Tamam nuclear amal, jaise nuclear reactions aur nuclear decays, baqa ke qawaneen par chalte hain, jaise:

items: Energy, momentum aur charge ki baqa. Is mein nucleon number (N) aur charge number (Z) shamil hain.

blocks.caption: For Your Information: hadrons aur non-hadrons
rows: protons, neutrons, omega, sigma aur lambda particles

blocks.prompt: Nitrogen-14 (Z = 7) par alpha particle marne se oxygen-17 (Z = 8) banta hai. Hasil hone wala zarra kya hai, aur dikhaiye ke nucleon number aur charge number baqi rehte hain (numerical 12.3, 12.4).
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen-14 + helium-4 -> oxygen-17 + X. Nucleons: 14 + 4 = 18 = 17 + A, to A = 1. Charge: 7 + 2 = 9 = 8 + Z, to Z = 1. Hasil zarra proton (hydrogen-1) hai. Nucleon number (pehle aur baad 18) aur charge number (pehle aur baad 9) dono baqi rehte hain.

items: Nuclear reactions aur decays energy, momentum aur charge (nucleon number aur charge number Z samet), baryon number aur lepton number baqi rakhte hain. Hadrons: mesons (pions, kaons) aur baryons (p, n, omega, sigma, lambda); non-hadrons: leptons, photons, gravitons.
